[[Arthas Menethil|Arthas]] (brother) }} Princess '''Calia Menethil''' was the daughter of King [[Terenas Menethil II]] and the older sister of [[Arthas Menethil]]. She was betrothed to Lord [[Deathwing|Daval Prestor]], the mysterious noble who was to replace the treacherous Lord [[Aiden Perenolde]] as the ruler of [[Alterac (kingdom)|Alterac]], but Prestor disappeared before any final arrangements were made. The fate of Calia following the novel ''[[Day of the Dragon]]'' has never been explained. ==Trivia== * She would likely be at least 10 years older than her brother, putting her somewhere in her late thirties or early forties. * [[Princess Calia Menethil's Copper Coin]] can be found in the fountain in [[Stormwind City]]'s [[Trade District]]. {{DEFAULTSORT:Menethil, Calia}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Lore characters]] [[Category:Lordaeron (kingdom)]]
